name: Tennessee Technological University
oos_note: Public university. Domestic out-of-state annual tuition & fees for 2026-27 from official TNTech Bursar Undergraduate On-Campus Fee Schedule PDF (TTU_Undergraduate_OnCampus_Fees_Accessible_Fall_2026.pdf). Full-time (12+ hrs flat rate) Domestic Out-of-State Total = $8,398.00/semester (In-State Total $6,298 including tuition + Program Service Fee, plus Out-of-State Tuition $2,100). Annual = $8,398 x 2 = $16,796. Excludes housing/meals/parking.
